changes.comment: Add hydration of prerendered content: an element whose host already holds the server's render of the same template does not render again, fires `did-render` once and is ready at once (never `delaying-ready`); `persist-content` keeps those nodes across toggles and `pre-fetch="idle"` does not run during a prerender
Fix an issue where a first mount into a `host-ref` selector cleared the host and fired `did-unrender`: what the host holds now stays until the first render replaces it
